text: You’re in the supermarket, picking up a few things. A gentle, familiar melody drifts through the aisles, almost unnoticed.
It’s just background, right? Part of the store’s atmosphere, making your shopping experience a little more pleasant, a little less stressful.
But this isn't just a random playlist. This calm, slow-tempo music is a carefully engineered part of the store's invisible system.
It subtly influences your internal pace. Your footsteps naturally slow down, your movements become less rushed, and you linger longer in each section.
The longer you spend browsing the shelves, the more likely you are to notice products you hadn’t planned to buy, leading to more impulse purchases.
So next time you hear that soothing tune, remember it’s not just for your enjoyment; it’s quietly guiding your shopping decisions.
